taxes.label: Taxes
taxes.rule: Creates, extends, or bans a tax, or changes how taxes are approved or limited.

budget.label: Budget & bonds
budget.rule: Borrows money through bonds; changes how the state saves, pays down debt, or limits spending; or changes state revenue by $1 billion or more a year.

housing.label: Housing
housing.rule: Builds, finances, or speeds approval of homes.

elections.label: Elections
elections.rule: Changes how voting, campaigns, or recalls work.

health.label: Health
health.rule: Funds or regulates health care, clinics, or medical research.

local.label: Local government
local.rule: Decided only by local voters, or a statewide measure aimed mainly at local governments' taxes or finances.

environment.label: Environment
environment.rule: Changes environmental review or protection rules.

schools.label: Schools
schools.rule: Funds public schools or community colleges, directly or through a large, fixed share of its revenue.
